Receive hypertension notifications just by wearing your watch.

Series 11 can notify you if it identifies patterns of hypertension. 1 How? The optical sensor provides data to an algorithm that can detect potential hypertension by analyzing how your blood vessels respond to beats of the heart over 30-day periods.

Keep an eye on sleep apnea.

Sleep apnea is a condition where people experience repeated interruptions in their regular respiratory pattern during sleep. If untreated, it can lead to increased risk of hypertension, type 2 diabetes, cardiac issues, and more. Series 11 is a sleep‑tracking wearable that can monitor for breathing disturbances over time and notify you of possible sleep apnea. 11
